"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/sum-of-scores-of-built-strings/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

2223. Sum of Scores of Built Strings

You are building a string s of length n one character at a time, prepending each new character to the front of the string. The strings are labeled from 1 to n, where the string with length i is labeled s_i.

For example, for s = "abaca", s_1 == "a", s_2 == "ca", s_3 == "aca", etc.

The score of s_i is the length of the longest common prefix between s_i and s_n (Note that s == s_n).

Given the final string s, return the sum of the score of every s_i.

Example 1:

Input: s = "babab"
Output: 9
Explanation:
For s_1 == "b", the longest common prefix is "b" which has a score of 1.
For s_2 == "ab", there is no common prefix so the score is 0.
For s_3 == "bab", the longest common prefix is "bab" which has a score of 3.
For s_4 == "abab", there is no common prefix so the score is 0.
For s_5 == "babab", the longest common prefix is "babab" which has a score of 5.
The sum of the scores is 1 + 0 + 3 + 0 + 5 = 9, so we return 9.

Example 2:

Input: s = "azbazbzaz"
Output: 14
Explanation:
For s_2 == "az", the longest common prefix is "az" which has a score of 2.
For s_6 == "azbzaz", the longest common prefix is "azb" which has a score of 3.
For s_9 == "azbazbzaz", the longest common prefix is "azbazbzaz" which has a score of 9.
For all other s_i, the score is 0.
The sum of the scores is 2 + 3 + 9 = 14, so we return 14.

Constraints:

    1 <= s.length <= 10^5
    s consists of lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def sumScores(self, s: str) -> int:
        # We want to find the sum of the longest common prefix lengths between s_i and s_n,
        # where s_i is the prefix of length i of the reversed string s reversed.
        # Since s_i is the prefix of length i of the reversed string s reversed,
        # and s_n is the full reversed string,
        # the problem reduces to sum of Z-array values of the reversed string.
        # The Z-array for a string S is an array where Z[i] is the length of the longest substring
        # starting at i which is also a prefix of S.
        # We can compute the Z-array for the reversed string and sum all values plus the length of s (for the full string).

        n = len(s)
        rev = s[::-1]
        Z = [0] * n
        l, r = 0, 0
        for i in range(1, n):
            if i <= r:
                Z[i] = min(r - i + 1, Z[i - l])
            while i + Z[i] < n and rev[Z[i]] == rev[i + Z[i]]:
                Z[i] += 1
            if i + Z[i] - 1 > r:
                l, r = i, i + Z[i] - 1
        return sum(Z) + n


sol = Solution()

print(sol.sumScores("babab"))  # 9

assert sol.sumScores("babab") == 9
assert sol.sumScores("azbazbzaz") == 14

assert sol.sumScores("a") == 1
assert sol.sumScores("aa") == 3
assert sol.sumScores("abcde") == 5
assert sol.sumScores("zzzzzzzzzz") == 55
assert sol.sumScores("ababababab") == 30
assert sol.sumScores("a" * 100000) == 5000050000
assert sol.sumScores("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" * 3846) == 192342306
assert sol.sumScores("z" * 99999 + "a") == 100000
assert sol.sumScores("a" * 50000 + "b" * 50000) == 1250075000
assert sol.sumScores("abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc") == 165
assert sol.sumScores("x" * 99999 + "y") == 100000
assert sol.sumScores("qwertyuiopasdfghjklzxcvbnm" * 3846) == 192342306
